page.overview:
Who is Darth Devastator?

Darth Devastator, born Dev Greebling and nicknamed Darth Dev, was a Force-sensitive human male individual who was the older brother of the nerf herder Sig Greebling. Alongside Sig, Dev discovered the artifact known as The Cornerstone of the Galaxy in a Jedi temple, resulting in the galaxy becoming mixed up. In this twisted version of the galaxy, Dev Greebling was the Sith Lord commanding the Empire, Darth Devastator. After finding himself in the new galaxy, Sig approached him upon seeing him, unaware that he was no longer the brother he knew. Darth Devastator captured him, along with Yesi Scala. Devastator ordered his apprentice, Darth Rey, to help interrogate the two, until Jedi Bob came to rescue them.

Dev Greebling appears in LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy, a non-canon LEGO Star Wars special released on September 13, 2024, portrayed by Tony Revolori.
